reason: I need full-site screenshots of our company site maybe three or four times a year, before a redesign or an audit, so a monthly subscription is paying for eleven months of nothing. And with zero reviews I'm not putting even the $79 lifetime on a card; at most I'd poke at the free tier, and 15 pages won't cover our site.
objection: It's brand new with no reviews and no proof it handles a real site with logins and heavy scripts, and the whole pitch is ongoing monitoring when what I actually need is an occasional one-off capture.
would_change_my_mind: A pay-per-capture option, say a one-off full-site run for a few dollars, backed by a handful of real reviews from in-house teams showing it works on sites like ours.
